cohort: The study included 151 primigravid mothers who delivered a live-born healthy infant after 37 weeks' gestation in a tertiary centre in South India.
finding: The incidence of postpartum depression was 18.5%, with 6% severe, and nearly one-third of mothers experienced maternal-infant bonding disorders, while all mothers reported good perceived maternal confidence.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was significantly associated with maternal-infant bonding disorders (OR = 10.3; 95% CI 2.13-47.21).
